parameters.text:
=Generate a complete content calendar for next week for FLOOWBOX.

Brand: FLOOWBOX (AI automation workflows for SMEs, n8n specialists)
Audience: Founders, operations managers, SME owners
Goal: Build authority in AI automation, generate leads

This Week's Trending Topics:
{{ $('Fetch This Week Trends').item.json.choices[0].message.content }}

Empty slots to fill: {{ $('Fetch Existing Content Gaps').all().length }} slots

Create 5 days × 2 posts each (Monday-Friday):
- LinkedIn post (authority building)
- Twitter/X post (engagement, shorter)

For each post include: topic, angle, hook (first line), key points, CTA, hashtags.
Tie at least 3 posts to this week's trending topics.

Return JSON:
{
  "week_theme": "",
  "posts": [
    {
      "day": "Monday",
      "platform": "LinkedIn",
      "topic": "",
      "angle": "",
      "hook": "",
      "key_points": [],
      "cta": "",
      "hashtags": [],
      "trend_connection": ""
    }
  ]
}

=📅 *Next Week Content Calendar — {{ $('Generate Full Week Content Plan').item.json.text ? JSON.parse($('Generate Full Week Content Plan').item.json.text.replace(/```json|```/g,'')).week_theme : '' }}*

10 posts created in Notion (5 days × 2 platforms).

*Monday hooks:*
{{ $input.all().filter(i=>i.json.day==='Monday').map(i=>`• [${i.json.platform}] ${i.json.hook}`).join('\n') }}

All posts in Notion for review before publishing.

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Content Calendar Auto-Filler
Runs every Sunday evening.
Fetches trending topics from the week.
Checks Notion for empty calendar slots.
GPT-4o generates 5 days × 2 posts (LinkedIn + Twitter).
Ties posts to current trending topics.
Creates Notion entry for each post.
Slack preview of Monday hooks.

Review and edit in Notion before publishing.
